spec.rawSql:
-- One row for the flow picture: the newest 15 s row of data_power_live.
-- The car's power is split by priority, not proportionally: PV covers the
-- household first, then battery charging; only the PV surplus goes to the
-- go-e. The rest comes from battery discharge (after the household), then
-- from the grid. Household = house_kw - goe_kw (house_kw includes the car).
with l as (
  select * from data_power_live order by time desc limit 1
), v as (
  select time,
         coalesce(pv_kw, 0) as pv,
         coalesce(grid_kw, 0) as grid,
         coalesce(battery_kw, 0) as bat,
         battery_soc as bat_soc,
         greatest(coalesce(house_kw, 0) - coalesce(goe_kw, 0), 0) as home,
         coalesce(goe_kw, 0) as goe
  from l
), s as (
  select v.*,
         least(goe, greatest(pv - home - greatest(bat, 0), 0)) as goe_pv
  from v
), s2 as (
  select s.*,
         least(goe - goe_pv,
               greatest(greatest(-bat, 0) - greatest(home - pv, 0), 0)) as goe_bat
  from s
), f as (
  select s2.*, greatest(goe - goe_pv - goe_bat, 0) as goe_grid,
         (select level from data_vehicle_energy_level order by time desc limit 1) as car_soc
  from s2
)
-- Today's highest 15-minute average grid import (local day, finished clock quarters only).
, m as (
  select max(kw) as grid_max
  from (
    select avg(greatest(grid_kw, 0)) as kw
    from data_power_live
    where time >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna') at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'
      and time < time_bucket('15 minutes', now())
    group by time_bucket('15 minutes', time)
  ) q
)
select
  to_char(time at time zone 'Europe/Vienna', 'HH24:MI:SS') as updated,
  case when time < now() - interval '2 minutes' then 'stale' else '' end as stale,
  to_char(pv, 'FM990.0') as pv_txt,
  to_char(abs(grid), 'FM990.0') as grid_txt,
  case when grid >= 0.05 then 'Import' when grid <= -0.05 then 'Export' else 'Grid' end as grid_name,
  coalesce(' (max ' || to_char(grid_max, 'FM990.0') || ' kW)', '') as grid_max_txt,
  to_char(abs(bat), 'FM990.0') as bat_txt,
  coalesce(round(bat_soc)::text || ' %', '–') as bat_soc_txt,
  to_char(home, 'FM990.0') as home_txt,
  to_char(goe, 'FM990.0') as goe_txt,
  coalesce(round(car_soc)::text || ' %', '–') as car_soc_txt,
  to_char(goe_pv, 'FM990.0') as goe_pv_txt,
  to_char(goe_bat, 'FM990.0') as goe_bat_txt,
  to_char(goe_grid, 'FM990.0') as goe_grid_txt,
  -- link targets, filled in by Ansible from grafana_flow_links
  '@@FLOW_LINK_PV@@' as link_pv,
  '@@FLOW_LINK_GRID@@' as link_grid,
  '@@FLOW_LINK_BATTERY@@' as link_battery,
  '@@FLOW_LINK_HOUSEHOLD@@' as link_household,
  '@@FLOW_LINK_WALLBOX@@' as link_wallbox,
  '@@FLOW_LINK_CAR@@' as link_car,
  -- line state: off when the value shows as 0.0 kW (below 50 W); fwd = along the drawn path, rev = against it
  case when pv >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as pv_cls,
  case when grid >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' when grid <= -0.05 then 'on rev' else 'off' end as grid_cls,
  case when bat <= -0.05 then 'on fwd' when bat >= 0.05 then 'on rev' else 'off' end as bat_cls,
  case when home >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as home_cls,
  case when goe >= 0.05 then 'on fwd' else 'off' end as goe_cls,
  case when goe >= 0.05 then '' else 'off' end as split_cls,
  -- line width class by power: < 1, < 3, < 5, < 8, >= 8 kW
  case when pv < 1 then 'w1' when pv < 3 then 'w2' when pv < 5 then 'w3' when pv < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as pv_w,
  case when abs(grid) < 1 then 'w1' when abs(grid) < 3 then 'w2' when abs(grid) < 5 then 'w3' when abs(grid) < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as grid_w,
  case when abs(bat) < 1 then 'w1' when abs(bat) < 3 then 'w2' when abs(bat) < 5 then 'w3' when abs(bat) < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as bat_w,
  case when home < 1 then 'w1' when home < 3 then 'w2' when home < 5 then 'w3' when home < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as home_w,
  case when goe < 1 then 'w1' when goe < 3 then 'w2' when goe < 5 then 'w3' when goe < 8 then 'w4' else 'w5' end as goe_w,
  -- the split bar under the wallbox, in percent
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_pv / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_pv,
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_bat / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_bat,
  coalesce(round((100 * goe_grid / nullif(goe, 0))::numeric, 1), 0) as bar_grid
from f, m;

spec.description: Live power from data_power_live (one row per 15 s), with the time of the row at the top; faded when it is older than 2 minutes. Moving dots show the direction, thicker lines carry more power, grey lines and nodes show 0.0 kW (below 50 W). Household is the house without the car (house_kw − goe_kw). The bar under the wallbox shows where the car's power comes from, by priority: PV covers the household and battery charging first, only the surplus goes to the car; the rest comes from battery discharge, then the grid. The bracket next to the grid shows today's highest grid import as a 15-minute average over the finished clock quarters (:00, :15, :30, :45) since local midnight, like the smart meter's quarter-hour values; export in the same quarter does not lower it. Car SOC from data_vehicle_energy_level. Each circle and its label link to a dashboard (grafana_flow_links in the Ansible role): PV, grid, battery, household and wallbox; the car label opens the vehicle. Under 200 px high the panel switches to a row of five circles without lines.
spec.title: Energy flow
